purpose: Golden baseline of the unchanged ari_signals Level 0 generator (docs/tasks/extract-ari-signals-features.md, step 0).
preprocessing: normalize(): lower-case columns; timestamp->date; pd.to_datetime(date, utc=True, errors='coerce'); dropna(date); sort by date; reset_index (copy of run_simulation_fast._normalize_csv)

modes.sim: timeseries_info(df.iloc[t-200:t+1].copy(), symbol, 'Simulation for {symbol} 1d on {YYYYMMDD}', tf='1d', params, normalized=True)

serialisation: json.dumps(doc, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=True; pd.Timestamp->isoformat(), numpy scalar->.item()), UTF-8, gzip(mtime=0). output_sha256 is of the uncompressed JSON bytes.
case_selection: fixed edges (200, 201, 365-367, 400, last, first bar with 200 weekly bars +-1, 5+5 mid-week bars in the last year) + 40 random bars (numpy default_rng(20261116)); live mode also bars [30, 60, 120, 199]
